items.text: Isn't yogurt an ultra-processed, sugar-laden snack that we should avoid buying when we're in the supermarket?

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: an ultra-processed, sugar-laden snack that we should avoid buying when we're in the supermarket

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: that we should avoid buying when we're in the supermarket

items.text: The truth is a bit more complicated, and it all depends on the yoghurt.
Some do have a high sugar and fat content, and offer few other health benefits.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: a high sugar and fat content

items.text: But when it comes to yoghurt, they are not the whole story.
Let's look at some of the potential benefits.
Yoghurt is made by fermenting milk, which produces a number of live bacterial cultures.

level1.label: 定语从句
level1.text: which produces a number of live bacterial cultures

items.text: These helpful bacteria interact with our gut flora and have been associated with better digestive health.
It's possible that this could lead to reduced symptoms in people with conditions such as Irritable Bowel Syndrome.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that this could lead to reduced symptoms in people with conditions such as Irritable Bowel Syndrome

items.text: It's also been suggested that regularly consuming yogurt could reduce inflammation and the risk of developing some kinds of bowel cancer.

level1.label: 主语从句
level1.text: that regularly consuming yogurt could reduce inflammation and the risk of developing some kinds of bowel cancer

items.text: However, many types of yoghurt available in shops are pasteurised, which kills most of the helpful bacteria.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: many types of yoghurt available in shops

level1.label: 定语从句
level1.text: which kills most of the helpful bacteria

items.text: As well as providing calcium, B vitamins and phosphorus, yogurt is high in protein.
Protein can be important for muscle development, bone strength, and for controlling our appetites.
Again, the choice of yoghurt can be important.
Strained Greek-style yoghurt is thicker than regular yoghurt and is particularly high in protein.
200g contains around double the amount of protein found in 200ml of milk.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: around double the amount of protein found in 200ml of milk

items.text: The effect of fat in yoghurt is more complex.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: The effect of fat in yoghurt

items.text: It is high in saturated fat which could be a risk factor for heart disease.

level1.label: 定语从句
level1.text: which could be a risk factor for heart disease

items.text: However, some studies suggest that saturated fat from whole milk, can provide beneficial forms of cholesterol which might protect heart health.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that saturated fat from whole milk, can provide beneficial forms of cholesterol which might protect heart health

items.text: However, more research in this area is needed, and current UK government advice is to look for low-fat yoghurt.
There are many potential benefits as long as we choose the right yoghurt.

level1.label: 条件状语从句
level1.text: as long as we choose the right yoghurt

items.text: Unsweetened Greek yoghurt that retains live bacteria is likely to be the best choice for our health.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: Unsweetened Greek yoghurt that retains live bacteria

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: likely to be the best choice
